title: Managed Environments: the Power Platform governance tier, its licensing condition and its controls
summary: The licensing conditions, deadlines, sharing restrictions and automation are supported by Microsoft documentation. Two admin paths stop before the final setting choices and should be completed. All cited pages were accessible in this check; the earlier fetch failures did not establish broken links.
